description: Painted sprite for the rebel king (?art=paint): one whole image, eyes painted in. Step 1 paints a full-body game pose from the reference crop, the style sheet and the SVG rig's pose; step 2 removes the background. Then tools/art/sprite.mjs trims it, thickens the outer outline and writes src/assets/sprites/rebel-king.webp.

steps.name: pose
steps.prompt: Full-body game sprite, painted as one single whole image, of the rebel KING from the first image, painted in the art style of the second image (a character select sheet). Use the third image only for the full-body pose and chunky proportions, not for its style. SUBJECT: the deposed old king, now a scruffy rebel. A gold crown with pointed tips, a red centre gem and two blue gems on its band, pulled low over his brow. Under the crown only a narrow strip of bare skin face with two small black dot eyes, no nose and no mouth showing, then a huge wild bushy brown beard and moustache that covers the whole lower face and spills down over his chest. A red cloak with a ragged hem over both shoulders with a thick cream fur collar, a faded blue tunic, a brown belt with a gold buckle, short brown boots. A chipped steel sword with a narrow straight blade, a gold crossguard and a brown grip, held upright in his right fist on the right side of the figure: the bare skin fist clearly wraps around the grip just under the crossguard, the blade rises straight up above the fist and a round gold pommel shows below the fist. Standing, three-quarter view facing right, feet visible, chunky and big-headed: the head, beard and crown are about half the figure's height. EYES: two small black dot eyes painted into the strip of skin between the crown and the beard, side by side, level, clearly visible. POSE: a natural, anatomically correct pose. Each arm hangs from its own shoulder, the elbows bend the natural way and the hands sit at the ends of the arms; nothing is backwards, reversed or twisted. The weapon is gripped firmly in the front fist with the fingers wrapped round it, never floating. SILHOUETTE: one clean, readable silhouette with simple chunky shapes and few interior lines, nothing thin dangling off it. A VERY thick black outer outline runs all the way round the whole silhouette, about twice as thick as the inner lines, so the figure reads clearly at 48 pixels tall. STYLE to match the second image exactly: bold flash-era 2D brawler cartoon, very thick even black outlines, flat fills, one hard cel shadow, crisp white highlights on metal, earthy colours with the red cloak as the one bright accent. One character only, centred, on a plain flat light grey background (#d8d8d8), no ground, no cast shadow, no text, no labels, no frame.
